## What changed

Describe the user problem and the behavior this PR changes.

## How you checked it

List the commands you ran and one result that shows the intended behavior.
For data or API changes, include the relevant failure or empty case.

## Data and source rights

If this adds or changes a job source, link its official terms or written
permission and explain attribution, retention, and removal. Never include API
keys, candidate records, or downloaded job dumps in the PR.
